image_description: A home entertainment setup featuring a central projection screen displaying a video game, flanked by four large black loudspeakers mounted on the wall. Two speakers are to the left and two to the right of the screen. Below the screen and speakers, long green palm-like leaves hang down, partially obscuring the lower part of the setup. The room has white walls and ceiling.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The leftmost speaker appears to float or merge ambiguously with the wall/ceiling corner. The mounting bracket is not clearly defined, and the edge of the speaker bleeds slightly into the white wall, suggesting a generation error in object-background separation.

The long green leaves hanging in the foreground have a slightly 'painted' or smudged texture. Some leaf tips terminate abruptly or blend into the background without clear depth separation, indicating minor generative artifacts in fine details.

The perspective lines on the right-side speakers do not perfectly align with the room's geometry. The rightmost speaker seems slightly warped, with the front baffle appearing non-planar relative to the adjacent speaker.
